verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a free migration app that moves code and users from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Bitbucket Cloud, and one community user mentions importing repos into Bitbucket. That is first-party repository import, but nothing shows issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments carried over, and the only documented source is Atlassian's own self-hosted product. missing for 10: import from third-party hosting platforms (e.g. GitHub/GitLab), migration of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, and in-depth import documentation with hands-on corroboration.
